name: sugar veins
source:
You wake up in a strange sugary world in a gingerbread house accompanied by a strange man who seems to know more than he is letting on. You only just got here and already you find this all strange.

Will you find a way out? Will you stay? Or will you meet your end?

[From [url=https://rosewoodstudios.itch.io/sugar-veins]itch.io[/url]]
